::: {.callout-note}
## Notation Note (Volume II Control-Affine Maps)

State dynamics follow $\dot x=f(x)+G(x)u$ with uppercase **$G$** for the input
map, per [NOTATION.md](../../../NOTATION.md). Columns are **$G_j=G(x)e_j$** (or
the constant column in a linear example). Lowercase **$g$** is reserved for the
gravity generalized-force vector in mechanics equations. Stochastic diffusion
directions are written **$\sigma_j$**, not $g_j$.
:::
